remaining_work: 11 of the 13 active devices on the Robot HAT's own BOM have no ce-parts folder: PAM8406D, XC6206P182MR, 74LVC1G08, SN74LVC1G125DBV, SN74LVC1G126DBVR, SIT3088E, AP63205, LM5050-1, LMA2718 (MK1), ASDMB 12 MHz (Y1), CAT24C32 (U4, DNP). They are PLACED as measured solids on the board; what they lack is a shelf record.
17 shelf electronic parts have no established position in the robot; each row above says what would settle it. None of them is placed, and none is rendered.
Two of the three custom boards are unbuilt: imu_to_dxl (no published outline) and the banana battery-contact PCB (see out/internals/other-boards.json).
